verses.sanskrit:
उत्तङ्क उवाच।
              ब्रूहि केशव तत्त्वेन त्वमध्यात्ममनिन्दितम्। श्रुत्वा श्रेयोऽभिधास्यामि शापं वा ते जनार्दन॥१॥
verses.english: Utanka said Do you, O Keshava, tell ine that faultless spiritual science. Having heard your discourse I shall ordain what is for your good or imprecate a curse to you O Janardana!

verses.sanskrit:
वासुदेव उवाच
              तमो रजश्च सत्वं च विद्धि भावान्मदाश्रयान्। तथा रुदान्वसून्वापि विद्धि मत्प्रभवान्द्विज॥२॥
verses.english: Vasudeva said Know that the three qualities of Ignorance, Darkness and Goodness exist, depending on me as their refuge. So also, O twice-born one, know that the Rudras and the Vasus have originated from me.

verses.sanskrit: मयि सर्वाणि भूतानि सर्वभूतेषु चाप्यहम्। स्थित इत्यभिजानीहि मा तेऽभूदत्र संशयः॥३॥
verses.english: In me are all creatures, and in all creatures do I exist know this. Let no doubt arise in your mind about this.

verses.sanskrit: तथा दैत्यगणान्सर्वान्यक्षगन्धर्वराक्षसान्। नागानप्सरसश्चैव विद्धि मत्प्रभवान्द्विज॥४॥
verses.english: So also, O twice-born one, know that all the tribes of the Daityas, all the Yakshas, Gandharvas, Rakshasas, Nagas, Apsaras, have originated from me.

verses.sanskrit: सदसच्चैव यत्प्राहुरव्यक्तं व्यक्तमेव च। अक्षरं च क्षरं चैव सर्वमेतन्मदात्मकम्॥५॥
ये चाश्रमेषु वै धर्माश्चतुर्धा विदिता मुने। वैदिकानि च सर्वाणि विद्धि सर्वं मदात्मकम्॥६॥
verses.english: Those fourfold courses of duty which, O ascetic, are known to attach to the (four) modes of life, and all the Vedic duties, have me for their soul.

verses.sanskrit: असच्च सदसच्चैव यद्विश्वं सदसत्परम्। मत्तः परतरं नास्ति देवदेवात्सनातनात्॥७॥
verses.english: Whatever is non-existent, whatever is existent and non-existent, and whatever is above that which is existent and not existent, all these which form the universe-are from me. There is nothing higher (or beyond) me who am the eternal god of gods.

verses.sanskrit: ओङ्कारप्रमुखान्वेदान्विद्धि मां त्वं भृगूद्वह। यूपं सोमं चरुं होमं त्रिदशाप्यायनं मखे॥८॥
verses.english: O perpetuator of Bhrigu's race, know that all the Veda beginning with the original syllable) One are at one with me. Know, O son of Bhrigu's race, that I am the sacrificial stake; I am the Soma (drunk in sacrifices); I am the Charu (cooked in sacrifices for being offered to the deities); I am the Homa (that is performed); I am those deeds which sacrificers perform for pleasing the celestials; I am even the pourer of the sacrificial libation; and I am the Havi or libation that is poured. I am the Adhvaryu. I am the Kalpaka; and I am the highly sanctified sacrificial Havi. It is me whom the Udgatri, in the great sacrifice, hymns by the sound of his songs. In all rites of expiation, O Brahmana, the utters of auspicious Mantras and bencdictions fraught with peace sing my praises who am the artificer, o foremost of twice-born ones, of the universe.
verses.bhavadeepa: असत् शशशृङ्गादि सदसत् घटादि सदसत्परम् अव्यक्तम् एतत्त्रयमपि तत्त्वतः मत्तः परं नास्तीत्यर्थः॥७॥

verses.sanskrit: होतारमपि हव्यं च विद्धि मां भृगुनन्दन। अध्वर्युः कल्पकश्चापि हविः परमसंस्कृतम्॥९॥
उद्गाता चापि मां स्तौति गीतघोषैर्महाध्वरे। प्रायश्चित्तेषु मां ब्रह्मन् शान्तिमङ्गलवाचकाः॥१०॥
स्तुवन्ति विश्वकर्माणं सततं द्विजसत्तम। मम विद्धि सुतं धर्ममग्रजं द्विजसत्तम॥११॥
मानसं दयितं विप्र सर्वभूतदयात्मकम्। तत्राहं वर्तमानैश्च निवृत्तैश्चैव मानवैः॥१२॥
बह्वीः संसरमाणो वै योनीर्वामि सत्तम। धर्मसंरक्षणार्थाय धर्मसंस्थापनाय च॥१३॥
verses.english: Constantly changing myself, I take birth in various wombs. O best of men, for upholding that son of mine, with the help of men now existing in or departed from the world. Indeed, I do this for protecting Virtue and for establishing it.

verses.sanskrit: तैस्तैर्वेषैश्च रूपैश्च त्रिषु लोकेषु भार्गव। अहं विष्णुरहं ब्रह्मा शक्रोऽथ प्रभवाप्ययः॥१४॥
verses.english: In those forms that I assume for the purpose, I am known, O son of Bhrigu's race, in the three worlds as Vishnu and Brahman and Shakra. I am the origin and I am the destruction of all things.

verses.sanskrit: भूतग्रामस्य सर्वस्य स्रष्टा संहार एव च। अधर्मे वर्तमानानां सर्वेषामहमच्युतः॥१५॥
verses.english: I am the creator of al existent objects and I am their destroyer. Knowing no change myself, I am the destroyer of all those creatures that live in sinfulness.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मस्य सेतुं बध्नामि चलिते चलिते युगे। तास्ता योनीः प्रविश्याहं प्रजानां हितकाम्यया॥१६॥
यदा त्वहं देवयोनौ वर्तामि भृगुनन्दन। तदाहं देववत्सर्वमाचरामि न संशयः॥१७॥
यदा गन्धर्वयोनौ वा वर्तामि भृगुनन्दन। तदा गन्धर्ववत्सर्वमाचरामि न संशयः॥१८॥
verses.english: When I live in the order of the Gandharvas, I then, O son of Bhrigu's race, act in every . respect as a Gandharva.

verses.sanskrit: नागयोनौ यदा चैव तथा वर्तामि नागवत्। यक्षराक्षसयोन्योस्तु यथावद्विचराम्यहम्॥१९॥
verses.english: When I live in the order of the Nagas I then act as a Naga, and when I live in the order of Yakshas or that of Rakshasas, I act after the manner of that order.

verses.sanskrit: मानुष्ये वर्तमाने तु कृपणं याचिता मया। न च ते जानसम्मोहा वचोऽगृह्णन्त मे हितम्॥२०॥
भयं च महदुद्दिश्य त्रासिताः कुरवो मया। क्रुद्धेन भूत्वा तु पुनर्यथावदनुदर्शिताः॥२१॥
verses.english: I frightened them, filled with anger referring to some great fear. But once more I showed themselves my usual human forin.

verses.sanskrit: तेऽधर्मेणेह संयुक्ताः परीताः कालधर्मणा। धर्मेण निहता युद्धे गताः स्वर्गं न संशयः॥२२॥
लोकेषु पाण्डवाश्चैव गताः ख्यातिं द्विजोत्तम। एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि॥२३॥
